subject: Payment ramp, VAT split & temporary credit ceiling — action items
messages:
From: Miguel Santos <miguel.santos@aureliahealth.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Aurelia Finance <finance@aureliahealth.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Sep 2025 16:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: draft SOW and payment proposal

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the updated SOW. We're trying to reconcile this with our treasury schedule for Q4 — a couple of asks before we can get PO/release: 

- Can Redwood offer a short-term credit ceiling for the transition period? Our initial usage will spike in November; we'd prefer not to renegotiate net terms mid-quarter. Suggestion: a temporary credit cap of EUR 120k for 60 days.
- VAT handling: Our accountants noted the SOW lists Redwood UK as the billing entity but the services will be consumed by our EU entity. We need confirmation you can issue invoices with VAT reverse-charge or provide VAT-exempt intracommunity billing as appropriate.
- Payment ramp: is it possible to break the first quarterly invoice into two installments (50% on delivery, 50% 30 days later) to smooth our cash flow?

I've attached our standard procurement checklist and current invoice (for reference). If you can point to the contract clause that covers temporary credit ceilings and VAT treatment that will help get this to procurement quicker.

Best,
Miguel
Head of Procurement — Aurelia Health

Attachments: procurement-checklist.pdf (stub), current-invoice-20250831.pdf (stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Miguel Santos <miguel.santos@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 11 Sep 2025 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: draft SOW and payment proposal

Miguel — thanks for the clear asks. Quick responses below and next steps.

1) Temporary credit ceiling: we can approve a 60-day temporary ceiling of EUR 125,000 as a one-time exception pending sign-off from Finance. That would be tied to the signed SOW and a mutual action plan (MAP) that includes predictable usage caps. I'll need legal to add a short amendment; Connor can you own the amendment and loop Legal?

2) VAT / billing entity: Redwood can bill from Redwood EMEA Ltd and support reverse-charge if you can provide your EU VAT registration (VATIN). If you prefer an intragroup VAT-exempt invoice, we need the purchasing entity name and VATIN. I'll attach a short VAT evidence checklist.

3) Payment ramp: splitting first invoice 50/50 is acceptable for this deal. We'll produce two invoices dated on delivery and 30 days after delivery respectively. Note: splitting affects our revenue recognition tagging but Finance is ok for this case.

Next steps: 
- Connor: draft the 60-day credit ceiling amendment and include the MAP language (usage caps & monitoring).
- Lauren: confirm Finance sign-off and create the billing flow so we can issue the two invoices.
- Miguel: send your EU VATIN and the exact purchasing entity name.

I'll attach the proposed payment schedule template and the VAT evidence checklist to this thread.

Thanks — Marissa
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: draft SOW and payment proposal

Looping in with a brief draft of the amendment language below — Miguel, please confirm this reflects Aurelia's expectation and we'll push a short addendum: 

----- DRAFT ADDENDUM (for signature) -----
1) Temporary Credit Ceiling: Redwood agrees to extend a one-time temporary credit ceiling of EUR 125,000 to Aurelia Health for a period of sixty (60) days commencing on the Effective Date of the SOW. The credit ceiling will be rescinded if actual usage exceeds 120% of the MAP usage estimate without prior written agreement.
2) Payment Schedule: The initial invoice associated with the Delivery Milestone shall be split into two invoices: 50% upon delivery (Invoice A), 50% due 30 days after Invoice A (Invoice B). Late payments subject to standard terms (1.5% monthly).
3) VAT and Billing: Redwood will issue invoices from Redwood EMEA Ltd. Subject to receipt of Aurelia's EU VAT registration number, invoices will either be processed under reverse-charge or adjusted to the purchasing entity's VAT-exempt status as required by EU VAT rules.
4) Monitoring & Alerts: Redwood will provide weekly usage summaries to Aurelia Finance for the 60-day period and will trigger a notification if consumption reaches 80% of the temporary credit ceiling.

Please confirm or suggest edits. Once Miguel confirms, I'll route to Legal for a two-signature addendum.

—Connor
